brief:
Civil defense teams in Gaza recovered 13 bodies from beneath the rubble of destroyed homes and buildings on Saturday, Shehab Wire reported. The recoveries followed difficult search and investigation operations conducted by rescue squads across multiple locations throughout the territory.

The recovery efforts underscored the scale of destruction across Gaza, where collapsed structures continue to hamper rescue operations. Civil defense personnel have conducted ongoing searches in damaged residential areas as they work to locate and recover remains from beneath accumulated debris across the devastated neighborhoods.
